m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I don't know any wet cat! Go bother the Pira'Nya Scissor Teeth!
Underwater cat? Sounds delicious! Where can we get one? You don't know either? Ask the Axantho Crabs!
Ozel Underwater Cat? I do not know, but Tzapotec might! He is the champion crab! Challenge him in his lair, not me!
How dare you enter my cave, shellless one! I'll snap you in two with my claws!
Ooooo. I think my shell is cracked. I need fresh water! Follow me outside!
By Mother Moon, you are pushy! Give an old crab a moment, won't you?
You need to get into the Pyramid of Mother Moon? Hrrrrrrrrmm.
The Shadow has crawled into the heart of Mother Moon! You must slice out this black stain, Azure Shining One.
You need to enter the Pyramid of Mother Moon as her children used to do. You must walk the path of priests. But I am a humble statue.
All the priests are dead and gone. Wait. You need Ozel Underwater Cat. He is dead, and not a priest, but also not gone.
He should know the way in. How do you find Ozel Underwater Cat? I don't know. Ask the Kronosaurs. Forcefully.
Ozel Underwater Cat can teach you the path of the priests. To find him, beat an answer from the Kronosaurs.
